subject.title: Roadmap: Station profiles for supervised agent workloads and reasoning access

question: Should Crabbox approve a credential-free generic Station Phase 1 now, with https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/530 and modelAccess remaining later separately reviewed phases?
rationale: Current code establishes safety gates but intentionally leaves the public lifecycle, persistence, supervision, status, and provider contracts to maintainer product judgment.

options.title: Approve Phase 1 decomposition
options.body: Create a bounded design and implementation track for durable SSH-backed Station lifecycle without agent or model credentials.

options.title: Keep the roadmap deferred
options.body: Retain the disabled contracts until a concrete consumer and live provider validation plan justify the new lifecycle primitive.

options.title: Prioritize the agent bridge
options.body: Advance https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/530 before generic Station despite the sequencing documented on current main.

recommendation.title: Approve Phase 1 decomposition
recommendation.body: Create a bounded design and implementation track for durable SSH-backed Station lifecycle without agent or model credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the Station boundary onto main and introduced the contract connecting the agent-runtime work to it.
